summary_bullets: Make the shell renderer the single source for progress timing detail.
Remove stale Mermaid setup and renderer docs after the ASCII chart migration.
Clarify timing-ledger skill filtering and retired-script basename behavior.
commit_message:
Use shell renderer for progress timing charts

Delegate progress review detail entirely to render-review-phase-detail.sh, remove the duplicate Python timing chart path, and keep argv coverage on the raised renderer timeout.

Drop stale test-harness Mermaid CI setup and update renderer, linting, and migration docs for the current ASCII and basename-check contracts.
